title_zh: 听朋友诉说咖啡馆停业并约定陪同取物

scenario.label_zh: 突发店铺关闭后的陪伴
scenario.goal_zh: 听取朋友因家庭咖啡馆突然停业而震惊的感受，约定周六陪同取回个人物品

context_zh: 朋友谈论虚构家庭咖啡馆停业带来的失落，没有真实商业指控或法律意见。
author: author-phase09-a

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: My parents closed the cafe yesterday. They had been considering it, but I thought we had another month.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: That must have been a shock, especially after spending so much time there.

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: I am still shocked by how quickly it happened. My sketchbooks are all in the back room.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Would you like company when you collect them? We do not have to talk about the closure if you do not want to.

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: Yes, please. My parents will let me in on Saturday morning.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Then I'll meet you outside at ten on Saturday and help carry your things.

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: Thank you. Ten works, and having someone there will make it easier.

targets.sense_zh: 令人震惊的经历或感受
